name: Performance-Warning Trap
description: By explicitly warning that naive sequential assignment evaluates an overwhelmingly large number of partial states, the prompt tricks models into using search heuristics (like Minimum Remaining Values or degree-based vertex ordering) to avoid a time-limit exceedance. These heuristics find a valid assignment quickly but destroy the natural search order required to find the lexicographically smallest assignment, causing the model to return an incorrect sequence.
